camel_example: aliyun devops GET /api/v4/projects/merge_requests/advanced_search --region cn-hangzhou --pageSize 10 --orderBy updated_at --projectIds '2308912,_2308913' --sort desc --accessToken f0b1e61db5961df5975a93f9129d2513 --createdAfter '2019-03-15T08:00:00Z' --organizationId 60de7a6852743a5162b5f957 --filter new --reviewerIds 1234567890123 --search 'test-search' --labelIds b5b5738b94954bc6aa5a293316ed1d24 --groupIds '889910,_889911' --page 1 --state opened --createdBefore '2019-03-15T08:00:00Z' --authorIds 1234567890 --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en:
Queries a list of merge requests with support for pagination, sorting, and filtering.

This API can query both legacy and new merge requests. If you have never used legacy merge requests or no legacy merge request data exists, ignore the fields related to legacy merge requests in the response
description_zh:
查询合并请求列表，支持分页、排序和筛选。

该API能同时查询旧版和新版的合并请求，若没有使用过旧版合并请求，或者已经没有旧版合并请求数据，那么直接忽略返回信息中跟旧版合并请求相关的字段
name: ListMergeRequests

parameters.help_en: The organization ID, in string format. You can obtain this ID from the Yunxiao access URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/<OrganizationId>
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en:
The personal access token.
This field is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AK/SK pair or STS temporary authorization
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，默认值为1，从第1页开始
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小，默认值为20，取值范围【1,100】
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The code group IDs. Multiple IDs are separated by commas
parameters.help_zh: 代码组ID，支持多个ID，以逗号分隔
parameters.name: group_ids

parameters.help_en: The repository IDs. Multiple IDs are separated by commas
parameters.help_zh: 代码库ID，支持多个ID，以逗号分隔
parameters.name: project_ids

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account IDs of the creators. Multiple IDs are separated by commas
parameters.help_zh: 创建人阿里云账号ID，支持多个，以逗号分隔
parameters.name: author_ids

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account IDs of the reviewers. Multiple IDs are separated by commas
parameters.help_zh: 评审人阿里云账号ID，支持多个，以逗号分隔
parameters.name: reviewer_ids

parameters.help_en:
The merge request state. By default, merge requests in all states are queried. Valid values:
- opened: open, including the under review, to be merged, and under development states.
- closed: closed.
- merged: merged.
- all: all states. If the value is all, you do not need to pass this parameter. Other invalid characters also default to querying all states
parameters.help_zh:
合并请求状态，默认查询所有状态
- opened：已开启，包含评审中、待合并、待开发状态
- closed：已关闭
- merged：已合并
- all：所有，若是all，可以不用传值；其他无效字符，也默认查询所有
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Matches against the merge request title
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键字，匹配合并请求的标题
parameters.name: search

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort results. Default value: updated_at. Valid values:
- created_at: creation time.
- updated_at: update time.

If an invalid value is passed, updated_at is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认值为updated_at
- created_at：创建时间
- updated_at：更新时间

若传入其他无效字符，默认使用updated_at
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Default value: desc. Valid values:
- desc: descending order.
- asc: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，默认值为desc
- desc：降序
- asc：升序
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en:
Filters merge requests by version. By default, no filtering is applied and both new and legacy merge requests are returned. If you have always used the new merge request version, you can ignore this parameter. Valid values:
- new: queries only new merge requests.
- old: queries only legacy merge requests
parameters.help_zh:
该字段主要用于过滤新旧版本的合并请求，默认不过滤，同时获取新旧版本的内容，若是一直使用新版合并请求，可忽略该参数。可选值：
- new：仅查询新版合并请求
- old：仅查询旧版合并请求
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The label IDs. Multiple IDs are separated by commas
parameters.help_zh: 类标ID列表，多个ID以逗号分隔
parameters.name: label_ids

parameters.help_en:
The start of the creation time range.

> ISO 8601 format, such as 2019-03-15T08:00:00Z. The comparison is "greater than or equal to"
parameters.help_zh:
起始创建时间

> ISO 8601格式，如2019-03-15T08:00:00Z，大小比较为 "大于等于"
parameters.name: created_before

parameters.help_en:
The end of the creation time range.


> ISO 8601 format, such as 2019-03-15T08:00:00Z. The comparison is "less than".


> The creation time range is [createdBefore, createdAfter), which is a left-closed, right-open interval
parameters.help_zh:
截止创建时间


> ISO 8601格式，如2019-03-15T08:00:00Z，大小比较为 "小于"


> 创建时间范围：[createdBefore, createdAfter)，即左闭右开区间
parameters.name: created_after
